mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT al.security_type ,dst.security_type_name FROM ip_adjust_log_fund al INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = al.security_type AND dst.category_type = 'fund' AND dst.is_deleted = 0 WHERE al.is_deleted = 0 AND al.security_type IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dst.sort_order ASC ,al.security_type ASC
